summary: Deepened the covering player's shade (0.82 own half / 0.76 their half) to sit closer to our own goal when we attack, cutting off the late through-ball counters that cost us m18, and added a goal-line clearance: when the presser is on a ball within 5m of our own goal he hoofs it upfield instead of dribbling across his own six-yard line. Lint clean, 60s practice played clean.
